verdict: Paid campaigns paused 11 days ago; organic traffic is holding steady.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns went dark on August 6th and have not run since, meaning the 50 leads and $1,267.48 in spend reported this 28-day period all came before that cutoff. The last three days have produced zero new paid leads — this is a full stop, not a slow week. Organic search has remained intact throughout, averaging around 17 clicks per day from Google Search during the pause, and site sessions are up notably week-over-week. Paid activity is being restarted, and the pipeline is being reviewed to ensure leads from the active spend period are properly processing. Once campaigns are back on, lead volume should return to prior pacing within a few days.
